summary: With a load balancer in front of several platform gateways, TLS can be terminated at the load balancer or passed through; if terminated, re-encrypt traffic to the AAP servers for end-to-end encryption and keep the `*_disable_https` variables at `false`.
questions: Should I terminate TLS at the load balancer for AAP?
Do I need HTTPS between the load balancer and platform gateway?
Can I disable HTTPS on gateways behind a load balancer?
